contexts.text: That the mutilated were healed, signified that such as are signified by... the mutilated would receive the Gospel, and be spiritually healed; and this by the Advent of the Lord into the world.
Thou shalt not kill, in the natural sense, means... also not to mutilate a man's body.
(Spirits who speak otherwise than they think) are at once cast out, and mutilated.
Hence... from its first revelation, the Word as to the sense of the letter has not been mutilated...
